status: PASS READ-ONLY RECONCILIATION; M770 BLOCKER PRESERVED
scope: Read-only reconciliation of existing browser, page-main, and bridge transports after M770.

transportInventory.source: browser control contract and M770 direct observation
transportInventory.finding: The evaluator supports read-only page inspection but did not expose the Foundry page-main global; the M770 fixed query was therefore not dispatched.

The fixed bridge is intentionally constrained to the-ballad-of-chauser-bill, elected GM handshake, and its eight named operations. It does not target dbx-test-world or expose runtime-evidence. Reconfiguration or socket use is outside M771.
The stdio adapter deliberately constructs a safe-mode profile and never discovers a world, opens a socket, or enables mutation; it cannot observe the live fixture.
The installed module exposes a fixed runtime-evidence query with mutation disabled, but no existing v4 user-visible no-write diagnostic control renders its redacted result to the DOM.

decision.selectedNextSlice: M772 package-owned visible read-only runtime-evidence diagnostic control
decision.rationale: A fixed module-owned GM-visible control can invoke the already allowlisted query in Foundry page-main and render only a redacted structured receipt for browser reread, without arbitrary scripts, eval, generic executors, or raw sockets.
